items.question: Does it replace my calendar?
items.answer: No. Sundial reads and writes the Google, Microsoft or iCloud calendar you already have, so everyone else keeps seeing your events where they always did.

items.question: What happens to a focus block when a meeting lands on it?
items.answer: It moves to the next free hour of the same kind, the same day if it can. You get a note saying where it went.

items.question: Can I leave?
items.answer: Any time. Your events were never ours: they stay in your own calendar, and your settings export as one file.
